observations: Industrial sewing machine mounted on a white table with an integrated ruler.
The brand 'XCELLENT-SEW' is printed in red on the machine arm in photos 0, 1, and 2.
A model plate below the handwheel in photo 0 shows the number '8700'.
The machine has red accents on the handwheel, tension assembly, and foot pedal.
A thread stand with two spool holders is visible in photo 2.
A drive belt is visible connecting the handwheel to the underside of the table in photo 0.
The table has a power switch mounted on the front right edge.
Photos contain a 'POSTED ON JIJI' watermark with the name 'KUCH ALEX'.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the brand 'XCELLENT-SEW' and the heavy-duty industrial form factor with a separate table and motor drive.

risks.risk: The motor (clutch or servo) under the table may be burnt out or missing.
risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and running at full speed.
risks.if_unproven: as having a non-functional motor requiring replacement.

risks.risk: Internal timing may be off, causing skipped stitches or needle breakage.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of a stitch sample produced by the machine on two layers of fabric.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring professional timing service and calibration.

risks.risk: The automatic oiling system (oil pump) may be blocked or failed.
risks.proof: A video showing oil splashing against the clear sight glass on top of the machine while running.
risks.if_unproven: as having a failed lubrication system, risking internal seizure.

risks.risk: The table or stand may be unstable or warped.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running to check for excessive vibration or wobbling.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged or low-quality stand.

proof_requests: A video of the machine running to hear the motor and see the needle movement.
A photo of the underside of the table to identify the motor type (clutch vs. servo).
A photo of a sewing sample made on the machine.
A clear, non-blurry photo of the model plate to confirm the exact sub-model.
response.reason: The brand and model (XCELLENT-SEW 8700) are clearly visible in the photos, allowing for a valuation based on the worst-case functional state.
